topic: Preparation for Rembol meeting and API status
summary_markdown:
The participants discussed preparation for an upcoming meeting with Rembol, which was scheduled to start after a specific date (2024-12-10).

Key discussion points included:
*   **API Status:** The API functionality will offer two modes: returning all data or returning only modified data since a specified date.
*   **Frame Zones:** One participant noted that work on zones around frames was not yet started, as campaign completion was the priority. This task is tracked in an internal system (DOOH-1541).
*   **Meeting Coordination:** The participants planned to discuss the API and frame zone plans internally before meeting with Rembol.
decisions: The API will provide two data retrieval modes: all data or post-date modified data.
action_items: Participants need to coordinate a call to align on the API and frame zone plans before the Rembol meeting.
